terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, SHA-256, HTTPS, NTFS, ReFS, GDI, PNG, JPEG, executable names, paths, switches, URLs and placeholders remain untranslated.
A saved screenshot or video item is 捕获内容; the act of capturing is 捕获, and binding detection never reuses the media term.
replay is 回放 rather than 重播, buffer is 缓冲区, clip is 片段, recording is 录制.
overlay is 叠加层, gallery is 图库, media library is 媒体库, sidebar is 侧边栏, tray is 托盘.
binding is 绑定, assignment is 分配, slot is 槽位, gesture is 手势, hold is 长按, tap is 轻触, combination is 组合.
controller is 手柄 throughout the product, matching Mainland gaming convention rather than 控制器.
Update security vocabulary is fixed: manifest is 清单, checksum is 校验和, signature is 签名, staging is 暂存, transaction is 事务, trust state is 信任状态.
portable is 便携, staged is 暂存, journal is 日志, schema is 架构, folder is 文件夹, and the portable scheme prefix stays literal.
DualSense face buttons are 叉键, 圆圈键, 方块键 and 三角键; Share, View, Guide and PS stay untranslated.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, source location, control role and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Prefer established Mainland Simplified Chinese product terminology over literal English syntax, but preserve protected technical names.
Use full-width Chinese punctuation in sentences and keep syntax tokens, placeholders and accelerators intact.
Reject machine-like phrasing even when structurally valid, including truncated clauses, repeated tokens and English word order.
Keep control labels concise and imperative; keep errors and warnings as natural complete sentences.
Resolve units made stale by the accepted English QA from the new English meaning, never from the superseded Chinese wording.
